title: P1: exclude retained worktrees from isolated repository verification fixtures
outOfScope: Deleting, moving, or cleaning retained local worktrees.
Weakening strict quality, fixture assertions, or documentation-alignment checks.
Changing production installer, release, or provider behavior.
Rewriting archived Work Item or Outcome evidence.

reasons: P1 corrective work changes strict-quality fixture isolation and must prove full-quality determinism.

acceptance: The canonical generator-chain test uses the shared root-copy helper instead of a local ignore list.
The capability-regeneration-chain test uses the shared root-copy helper instead of a local ignore list.
The project-governance view, governance-journey broken source, and system-invariant view use the shared runtime-state exclusion.

docs/reference/verification-fixture-boundary.md names retained .worktrees as excluded runtime state and states that fixture results are not provider or production evidence.
guidelines: Treat retained .worktrees and caches as runtime state, not fixture source input.
Use one shared, test-only copy boundary rather than repeating divergent ignore lists.
Preserve each fixture's production-source coverage and fail closed if its required source is missing.
Do not delete worktrees or weaken quality to make a fixture faster.

intent.problem: Strict quality for #704 copied the template checkout into a temporary fixture without excluding retained .worktrees. The checkout contains governed historical worktrees, so the canonical generator fixture recursively copied hundreds of megabytes and stalled the quality lane.
constraints: Do not relax strict quality or turn the fix into a machine-local exception.
Cover every fixture that copies the repository root, not only the observed test.
Keep the helper test-only and preserve behavior required by generator and governance fixtures.
intent.rationale: A shared runtime-state exclusion makes isolated repository fixtures deterministic, bounded, and auditable while retaining the source tree they are intended to verify.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized automatic execution, asked for corrective Work Items before process repairs, and prohibited temporary cleanup workarounds.
